thread:
Elena: quick PM follow-up: we saw another burst of 5xxs during the overnight deploy window. need a small set of actions: dedupe window, group-by instance, deploy suppressions, and a night/weekend paging matrix. who can pick up which?
Victor: I can own the prometheus rule changes. thinking 5m eval + group_by(instance) + an 8m dedupe window. will open a staging PR today.
Marta: Ill draft the paging policy (night/weekend matrix + `no_page` for warning-level). also add suppression tags for scheduled deploys. draft by tomorrow noon.
infra-bot: Automated: 5xx burst pattern detected (last 7d = 6 events). Correlated tag: deploy=canary. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/5xx-bursts
Victor: quick prometheus snippet for staging:
```
alert: Backend5xxBurst
expr: increase(http_responses_total{status=~"5.."}[5m]) > 30
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: warning
  dedupe_window: "8m"
  group_by: "job,instance"
annotations:
  runbook: "https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/runbooks/5xx-burst.md"
```
This should reduce paging from single-host flurries.
Marta: for paging matrix: page on `severity=critical` OR `for >= 10m`. add an explicit `no_page: true` label for chatty warnings and `suppress_during: deploy_window` tag.
QA-team: can we get a quick smoke test in staging after the rule change? we'll run a synthetic 5xx generator to verify dedupe behavior.
Victor: yes, will coordinate with QA-team and tag the PR.
Elena: assigning items & due dates: Victor (prometheus rule + staging test, due: today EOD), Marta (paging doc + suppressions, due: tomorrow noon), QA-team (staging validation, due: tomorrow EOD). please ack. I'll add these to the postmortem follow-up tracker and run a weekly check until closed. ping me or @pagerduty if blocked. :white_check_mark:
